blocchi.nota: history of open interest by token starts 2026-09-03: percentiles are on the days available, fewer than 90, and days with fewer than 90% of the tokens are left out; the families add up to the 197 tokens of the total; funding and account ratio use the tokens of the family that have the reading that day; today's family members are applied to the whole history; Memecoins and AI and compute are the public CoinGecko categories 'Meme' and 'Artificial Intelligence (AI)', as downloaded on 7 Oct 2026; a token in more than one category goes to the category with the larger market value

frasi.testo: Leverage regime: Mixed since 3 Oct 2026; 2 of 6 gauges expanded over 30 days
Open interest in perpetual futures across 197 tokens rose 7.2% in 30 days, to $22.4B
Open interest was 0.84% of market value across 197 tokens, down from 0.85% 30 days earlier
9 of 197 tokens paid above the standard funding rate, against 15 30 days earlier
Implied volatility on Bitcoin options (DVOL) was 36.1, the 12th percentile of the past year
Liquidations in perpetual futures were $5.47B in 30 days, down 14% from the 30 days before

dati.metodo: one set of 197 tokens for every value and sentence: tokens with open interest on Binance perpetuals, market value and funding both on the day and 30 days earlier; per family: open interest divided by the market value of the same tokens; funding and account ratio weighted by open interest; flat inside a band of 5% for the ratio
dati.cancello_nota: gate result for the sentences: ok = at least one sentence passed; each sentence carries its own result; the values in tables and history are not certified one by one
